title: Chandu Champion
desc: An extraordinary man confronts relentless challenges with unwavering determination. His spirit and resilience propel him through adversity, ultimately forging a path to historic achievement.

title: Chor Machaaye Shor
desc: A thief pretends to be a policeman to extract a stolen diamond from the police headquarters. Although he becomes the ACP's favourite, a suspicious colleague tries to corner him with hilarious results.
When mobiles start flying from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and his robot Nila are asked to help. However, due to Pakshi Rajan having a hand in this, the two have to reinstate Chitti to defeat him.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Simmba
desc: Inspector Simmba is a corrupt officer who works for a major smuggler. He finds his values challenged as the gangster's brothers assault his sworn sister.

title: Dhadkan
desc: Anjali and Dev's love story faces a harsh twist when Anjali is forced to marry Ram. Years later, Dev returns to rekindle their romance, only to find that Anjali has grown to love her husband.

title: Fukrey 3
desc: The Fukras plan to take over Delhi and run for city elections. However, they have no money, so they take on an international job to make a quick buck, which changes their lives forever.

title: Table No. 21
desc: Financially struggling, Vivaan and Siya are offered a chance to participate in a game show.

title: Bharat
desc: During the independent nation of India, a family gets torn apart, leaving an eight-year-old boy who makes a promise to his father to keep the family together.

title: Jigarwala No. 1
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A woman is forced to abandon her Bollywood dreams after her boyfriend sells her to a brothel. As time passes, she builds strong connections in the criminal underworld and rises to power.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalein
desc: After graduating from a university in India, an unemployed man decides to try his luck in New York and gets caught in a love triangle between an equally unlucky girl and a rich girl.

title: Chennai vs China
desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

title: Jai Ho
desc: A former Indian military officer devises a unique plan to promote social responsibility amongst apathetic civilians. The masses embrace his initiative, but he must confront a potent political family.

title: Tumbbad
desc: Vinayak Rao, a resident of the village Tumbbad, repeatedly steals the ill-fated wealth of the evil Hastar, until his greed and heinous acts become the reason for his doom.
